title: K9 Feng Shui 7'x4.5x2.5' Deep Built in Water pond set Landscape Garden Water Feature Balinese Fish Waterfall 风水流水喷泉瀑布 A
description:
K9 Feng Shui 7'x4.5x2.5' Deep Built in Water pond set Landscape Garden Water Feature Balinese Fish Waterfall 风水流水喷泉瀑布 A
Please contact Ol6 26lO 522 for any inquiry, catalogue, RM 1200 discount or urgent order.

Package includes :
Fiberglass Pond x 1
Fiberglass Water fountain x 1
Water Pump x 1
Water Filter with UV Light x 1
Live plants (to be planted on ground. Planter box are not included).
Pebbles
Fiberglass Slab x 6
Package includes Delivery and Installation Service
Landscaping (Optional)

Dimension:
Fiberglass Pond Size:
213 cm (Length) x 137 cm (Width) x 76.2 cm (Depth)
Brim: 22 cm

Fiberglass Fountain
Total Fountain Height: 57 cm
Stand Height: 42 cm
Bowl: 55 cm (Length) x 55 cm (Width) x 15 cm (Height)

Requires minimum 2 Plug Points for
- 1 for Water pump
- 1 for Water Filter with UV Light (2 in 1)
- 1 for spotlight (Optional, add-on with extra charges)

Features :
- Water Fountain is mobile. You can placed it anywhere inside the pond.
- Backwash filter cleaning system for monthly cleaning. Do not need to change filter if you do backwash cleaning.
Deep pond suitable for fishes.
- Japan Technology Biological Filtration have been manufactured with advanced technology to provide you with the best quality pump for your pond or water feature.

Warranty :
Leaking problem : 10 years warranty
Water Pump, UV light and Water Filter : 6 months Warranty

Note:
Price includes digging soil. Extra RM 600 if required hacking on tile/cement flooring before placement of fish pond.
Fish is not included.

If you have Garden Landscape without a Koi pond, you’ll be missing a big part of the design. It is because a Koi Pond would brings a great Feng Shui to the environment.

With over 30 years of experience in the industry, no matter what the application, from the smallest water feature or pond to large recreational systems and commercial projects, we have everything you will need including technical support from start to finish.
Our standard is defined by the customer’s expectations being met or exceeded, not by our perceptions as a supplier.
